title: Write decoding after encoding
statement: For every optional work-tape write $b$ and every bit string $x$, the optional-write reader applied to the two-bit encoding of $b$ followed by $x$ succeeds and returns $b$ and $x$.
hypotheses_covered: An optional work-tape write b and a bit-string suffix x are specified
replaced:
For every optional work-tape write $b$ (write nothing, write the blank symbol,
write $0$, or write $1$) and every bit string $x$, the optional-write reader
applied to the two-bit dictionary code of $b$ ($00$, $01$, $10$, or $11$
respectively) followed by $x$ succeeds and returns $(b, x)$.
